detail.longDescription: Put Humans Where AI Errors Can’t Be Undone Rubber-stamp human gates offer false comfort. When reviewers face endless queues of benign AI outputs, attention vanishes and automation bias wins. Reserve human review strictly for actions that are hard to undo and slow to detect. Show reviewers raw diffs instead of agent narrative explanations, cap daily queues, and replace low-risk gates with deterministic rules, sampling, and circuit breakers. https:// hernanhuwyler.wordpress.com/20 26/10/31/human-review-of-ai-agents/
